purpose: Fifth research-only handoff sample for Claude/local CSM-capable backfill flow. Do not treat as production data until reviewed and transformed through the official workflow.

contentFlagModel.mappingNote: This pilot preserves CSM's visible category label and proposes the nearest app level. Claude/Coder should confirm the exact canonical mapper before writing production catalog data.

violence.summary: Mostly implied cartoon mayhem plus tense afterlife/devil themes that may scare younger children.

language.summary: No meaningful language concern surfaced in CSM's category data.

drinking.summary: Drinking, gambling, and smoking appear but are not glamorized.

entries.title: Fly Away Home

violence.summary: A fatal car crash is shown from inside the vehicle, hunters shoot at geese, and a police officer is struck.

romance.summary: A shower panic scene includes implied accidental nudity without visible nudity.

drinking.summary: Adults drink wine and beer, and a cigar appears in the background.

handoffNotes: The crash/death setup needs prose prominence even though CSM's violence label is only a little.

calibrationNotes: CSM's Sex/Romance/Nudity category creates a product naming issue when non-sexual nudity is the main concern.
Several 5+ titles include emotionally significant death, abandonment, or scary-theme prose even when numeric labels stay low.
Language is the first flag in this slice to rise to level 3 because of repeated mild profanity and insults.
handoffSummary.nextClaudeAction: Before production import, confirm how the app should name and explain the Romance slider when nudity rather than romance drives the CSM category.
